records.name: Large-lattice GIN pair generator
records.reason: Generator manufactures equal-magnitude opposite-sign pairs. Index speed is not a derivation of a Hubbard Gibbs measure or a model-preserving sign cure.

records.name: CDT reflection-paired and frustrated/chiral generators
records.reason: Reflection generator assigns opposite determinants by construction and cancels its complete signed sum to zero. Chiral generator assigns random unit phases and sign(Re phase), rather than integrating a declared Dirac determinant phase. No physical positive thermal partition or all-configurations measure is established by these generators.

records.name: CDT simplicial Dirac matrix
records.reason: A concrete matrix diagnostic exists, but it is distinct from the synthetic ensemble constructors and does not specify a complete lattice-gravity measure.

records.name: Sparse Kitaev wire
records.reason: Finite bilinear/boundary-mode model is a possible future family. No L0 thermal sampling representation was extracted in this review.

records.name: Kitaev honeycomb and 3D chiral-superconductor diagnostics
records.reason: Classes and mock index structures exist. A Hamiltonian/thermal measure, observable set and theorem-specific phase assumptions must be independently admitted before an L0 sign claim.

scope: These names appear in the earlier external catalog, but were not established as concrete sign-measure implementations by the selected local inventory. This is not a repository-wide absence proof.
